messages:
Aisha Patel: Hi team — open enrollment portal crashed for a bunch of new hires this morning during orientation. They couldn't finish plan elections or add dependents. Is there a formal extension we can apply?
Samira Khan: ugh, sorry about that. We're aware of the outage. HR Tech is looking into root cause. Short answer: yes we can make an exception for impacted people, need a small intake to document who was affected.
Aisha Patel: What do you need from me? I have a list of 6 new hires and screenshots showing errors.
Samira Khan: Please upload the list (name + employee ID + email) as CSV to the secure portal and attach screenshots. Use the subject "OpenEnrollOutage_Request" in the portal notes. Link: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload
BenefitsAdmin: Also need each person's desired elections and any dependent docs if they're adding someone (birth cert, marriage cert, SSN or note about pending). We can provisionally enroll and backdate if within carrier rules.
Aisha Patel: Got it. Can we extend the deadline for those people beyond the official cut-off? Open enroll ended 2026-11-01 but orientation group was blocked 11/01 09:00-10:30 PT.
HR Tech: Confirming outage window 2026-11-01 09:02-10:25 PT due to auth token issue. We've applied a backend fix and are running a hotpatch to prevent recurrence.
Samira Khan: We'll approve a short extension for employees who hit that outage window and submitted the intake within 5 business days. Effective manual window cutoff for impacted folks = 2026-11-08. We'll process elections as if submitted on 11/01 for retro carriers when allowed.
BenefitsAdmin: Note: carriers vary on retroactive changes. For new dependents, we'll request backdate to 11/01 but can't guarantee carrier approval. We'll document appeals if carriers deny.
Aisha Patel: Uploaded CSV "1795012345_orientation_blocked.csv" and screenshots to secure portal.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: do not post PII in Slack. Use secure upload: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload. Intake should include event timestamp and screenshots.
Samira Khan: Received files. We'll queue manual enrollments and reach out to each employee with a DocuSign dependent form if needed. Expect confirmations in 2-3 business days.
BenefitsAdmin: We'll keep this thread updated with carrier responses. If anyone else hits issues, escalate here and include portal upload ID.
Aisha Patel: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Samira Khan: Thanks for flagging. We’ll follow up with a short postmortem once HR Tech confirms full remediation.
